title: Nullpoint win BPL Challengers Stage 2026
body:
Nullpoint are the [[BPL Challengers Stage 2026]] champions.

**The run.** On the way to the final they got past Frozen Simians 22-20 (group a · round 1), Starling Coven 16-14 (group a · round 2), Crystal Laurels 2-0 (group a · round 3), Hanabi Union 2-0 (group a · round 4) and Ashen Styx 2-1 (group a · round 5).

**The MVP.** [[Hyvred]] was the standout player of the event, with a 1.29 rating over 10 maps, 194 kills and 32 MVP rounds.

**The roster.** The title-winning line-up: [[zhizyii]], [[candybar_isblue]], [[UtsuhoNull]], [[ssseiso]] and [[Kaito_Oshino]].

The title is worth 250 BPL points.
note: Nullpoint has no team page yet. If they are going pro, use Roster Tools, Promote to pro (Challengers rule: the champion becomes a pro team).

title: Nullpoint join the pro ranks
body:
[[Nullpoint]] are officially a pro team, playing under the tag 0PT.

They earned their place through BPL Challengers Stage 2026 champion.

**The roster.** [[candybar_isblue]] (#10), [[UtsuhoNull]] (#22), [[zhizyii]] (#109), [[Kaito_Oshino]] (#163) and [[ssseiso]] (#282).

The headline name is [[candybar_isblue]], currently #10 in the league. Their first ranking points will come at their next event.
